title: Synthetic language-richness fixture
full_text:
This synthetic lesson describes how careful observers notice patterns in ordinary life. It exists only to verify that a published language source is kept separate from an IELTS model essay.

A second paragraph provides enough structure for paragraph-level selection and source-location tests without reproducing any textbook content.
